transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I've been feeling really depressed and sad for a very long time now. It has been going on constantly for over two years, and I just can't seem to shake this heavy mood.
During these past two years, have there been times when the depression became much worse for at least two weeks in a row, or has it stayed about the same the whole time?
I'd say it has stayed about the same the whole time. It just feels like a constant, steady sadness that is always there in the background.
Along with this ongoing low mood, have you also had symptoms like low energy, poor sleep, low self-esteem, trouble concentrating, or feeling hopeless most days?
No, I haven't really experienced those specific symptoms. My energy and sleep are usually fine, and I don't really struggle with low self-esteem, trouble concentrating, or feeling hopeless.
Did these feelings start after a major stressful life event or change, like a breakup, job loss, or move?
I don't recall any specific major event or trigger that started these feelings. It just seemed to develop on its own, and I've been feeling this way for a little over two years now.
Over those two years, was there ever a period of two months or longer when you were not feeling depressed?
No, not at all. It has been completely continuous for the entire two years and one month. I haven't had a break of two months, or even a few weeks, where I felt like my normal self.
During this time, have you also lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy, or has it mainly been feeling sad?
It has definitely been more about the constant, heavy sadness rather than losing interest in my hobbies. I just feel this deep emptiness inside and find myself tearing up or crying a lot of the time.
Have you had a poor appetite or been overeating during this time?
Yes, I've definitely noticed a decrease in my appetite almost every day. I just don't feel like eating much, and my appetite has been really poor throughout this entire time.
Have you been having trouble sleeping, or sleeping much more than usual, during this time?
I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my sleep patterns. Sleep hasn't been a major issue for me during this time, and I seem to be sleeping about the same as I always have.
Have you been feeling low on energy or unusually tired most days during this time?
No, I haven't really noticed feeling unusually tired or low on energy. My energy levels have been pretty normal, so that hasn't been an issue for me.
Have you been struggling with low self-esteem or feeling especially down on yourself most days during this time?
I'm not quite sure, as I haven't really thought about it that way. I wouldn't say I struggle with low self-esteem or feeling down on myself.
